reproduction.method: Breadth-first traversal with deduplication and a strict resident-node cap
reproduction.description: Model the graph-discovery effect safely on a generated local graph with cycles, duplicates, and unreachable nodes.
differences: No external crawl, HTTP, URLs, HTML parsing, downloads, or execution of the original surfer.
A seeded 12-node adjacency list, with an isolated node, replaces web pages; at most nine reachable nodes are admitted.
FIFO traversal advances once per admitted node, eliminating the original retry-forever failure mode.

checks.name: Admission cap and unique-node invariant hold
Every admitted node is processed exactly once
Discovery depths have valid predecessor edges
Unreachable resident node is never admitted
Recorded edges exist in the resident graph
